Name: Excalibur The Legendary Blade
Author: velastar
Description:
[center]This mod replaces the Holy Blade with [b]Excalibur[/b], a legendary sword inspired by Arthurian myth.
The sprite has been carefully redesigned to match Stardew Valley’s vanilla art style while giving the weapon a more regal and majestic appearance. The blade has been refined with a silver finish and a subtle jewel detail, maintaining balance with the original game’s proportions and color palette.
Excalibur retains the Holy Blade’s original stats and functionality, this is a purely visual and name replacement designed to feel seamless within the game.[/center]
[center]have fun with it!⋆[/center]
